note: UI Styles Block adds three ui_styles_styles selectors (block/title/content) to the block-layout config form and stores them on block.block.<id> under third_party_settings.ui_styles.{block,title,content}, each a ui_styles.selected_mapping {selected, extra}. PreprocessBlock merges the classes onto attributes/title_attributes/content_attributes. No routes/permissions/settings form. Medium/hard cases are grounded in a real placed block (ui_styles_eval_block) and its third-party settings.

evals.prompt: With the UI Styles Block module, which three parts of a placed block can I apply UI Styles classes to, and where are those selections stored?
evals.expected_output: Three parts: block (wrapper), title, and content. They are stored on the block config entity block.block.<id> under third_party_settings.ui_styles.{block,title,content}, each a {selected, extra} mapping, and rendered onto attributes / title_attributes / content_attributes.

evals.prompt: There is no dedicated settings page for UI Styles Block. Where in the Drupal admin do I actually apply UI Styles classes to a specific block?
evals.expected_output: On the block's own configuration form, reached from Structure > Block layout (/admin/structure/block) by configuring or placing the block. UI Styles selectors for Block, Title and Content appear on that form.

evals.prompt: In UI Styles Block, how do the classes chosen for a block's content actually reach the rendered HTML?
evals.expected_output: PreprocessBlock (a block preprocess hook) reads the block's third_party_settings.ui_styles and merges each part's classes onto the corresponding template variable: attributes (block), title_attributes (title) and content_attributes (content) using AttributeHelper::mergeCollections.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a placed block with id 'ui_styles_eval_block' has UI Styles applied to its content. Inspect the live block configuration and give the extra CSS class applied to its content.
evals.expected_output: The class is ui-styles-eval-content: block.block.ui_styles_eval_block has third_party_settings.ui_styles.content.extra = 'ui-styles-eval-content'. Read with: drush cget block.block.ui_styles_eval_block third_party_settings.ui_styles

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a placed block with id 'ui_styles_eval_block'. Using UI Styles Block, apply the CSS class 'ui-styles-eval-applied' to that block (any part: block wrapper, title or content) and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set a ui_styles third-party setting on block.block.ui_styles_eval_block, e.g. $block->setThirdPartySetting('ui_styles', 'block', ['selected' => [], 'extra' => 'ui-styles-eval-applied'])->save(); (or via the block config form's Extra classes field). The class ends up in one of third_party_settings.ui_styles.{block,title,content}.
